answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the thread queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 291 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the river. The bridge index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 173 account operation therefore ties up 4 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
